summary_en: CCN Group executed a fixed-price acquisition of 5,000 shares at 1,617 yen per share on November 20, 2026 via ToSTNeT-3, totaling 8,085,000 yen or 0.6% of shares outstanding excluding treasury stock.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Purchase of Treasury Stock via Off-Hours Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief:
On November 19, 2026, CCN Group's Board of Directors resolved to execute a treasury stock acquisition via fixed-price off-hours trading. The company purchased 5,000 shares of its common stock at 1,617 yen per share on November 20, 2026 through the Tokyo Stock Exchange's ToSTNeT-3 system, with a total acquisition amount of 8,085,000 yen. This execution represents 0.6% of shares outstanding as of the settlement date, calculated from the company's disclosed treasury stock holdings of 906,000 shares (excluding treasury stock). The order was placed on the trading time-limited basis and was for a single execution on November 20.

The company stated that the purpose of treasury stock acquisition is to enable flexible capital allocation policy decisions in the future from the perspective of enhancing corporate value. The acquisition results were to be announced after the conclusion of trading at 8:45 AM on November 20, 2026.
